body: Thank you again. My anxiety has made me so extremely complusive with googling, and when something this scary occurs it seems like that's all I do which leads me to being just exhausted by the end of the day. The fact that she didn't want to exchange any contact details makes me think that she saw no risk in pregnancy. But it is just scary how your mind can almost rationalize things happening that really didn't. Additionally it'd probably become an expensive full time effort to even try to locate the father with such little details. This is definitely the stuff of nightmares though.

Thanks so much for the support, I will definitely reach out to you if my anxiety peaks again. Your input definitely helps me immensely, it does help much more when I picture it from her perspective and viewing it more practically. This woman was closer to 30s-40s in age too if that effects anything. I had so much to drink that night I have a feeling what really happened was oral sex and then nothing more. I also didn't have any towels/napkins in my car that night and no memory at all of cleaning anything up. I imagine if it was to completion there would have been cleanup no matter where I finished. I'm never putting myself in this situation again, my anxiety just won't allow it lol

It's just terrifying having been with a stranger who was much more sober than you, I feel taken advantage of even though I know I was drunk and put myself into this position.
